allOf.description: Binding pair atomicity: generation without binding id (or vice versa) is malformed for freshness.

description: Cross-plane execution correlation envelope. Evidence/correlation outside ANVIL; authority only inside ANVIL. Normative companion: CORRELATION_ENVELOPE_V1.md.

binding_generation.description: Binding incarnation. NEVER inferred, invented, or incremented outside ANVIL.

correlation_id.description: Lineage identity, minted ONLY by ANVIL/Postgres. Null marks a genuinely ambient record.

execution_binding_id.description: Durable binding identity (anvil.execution_bindings.public_id). Required with binding_generation for freshness.

execution_id.description: Stable logical execution identity (anvil.execution_bindings.execution_id wire form). Survives rebinds.

idempotency_key.description: Replay/dedup key. Same key twice = duplicate delivery.

observed_at.description: Emission time, RFC 3339 UTC. Metadata only — never an identity/join key.

plane_identity.description: Plane-native ids the producer already holds. Never mapped/guessed cross-plane.

schema.description: Wire schema version. Unknown values must be carried opaquely and evaluated UNKNOWN.

source_ref.description: Opaque pointer to the source record. Opaque to consumers.

title: Correlation Envelope V1 (wire anvil.correlation.v2)
